Set REA_REGEX_WORKER_HEAP_REQUEST_MIB in the environment that starts REA to a decimal integer from 7 to 16384, then restart REA. In a running MCP server, use update_analysis_settings with setting regex.worker_heap_request_mib and action set instead; the new value applies to new work without a REA restart. A positive Node --max-old-space-size, including NODE_OPTIONS, overrides this request and sets the effective heap. That flag is not limited by this setting's floor or maximum.
